sessionStart.command: bash -lc 'for root in "${RUNNER_DASHBOARD_REPO_ROOT}" "${RUNNER_DASHBOARD_DEPLOY_DIR}" "$HOME/actions-runners/dashboard/current" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"; do [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/scripts/agent-bus-hook-bridge.py" ] && exec python3 "$root/scripts/agent-bus-hook-bridge.py" session-start; done; exit 0'
